description: This file serves as a demo webpage showcasing how to define a custom CodeMirror mode that overlays Mustache templating syntax inside HTML. It includes HTML content with embedded JavaScript that defines the overlay mode and initializes the CodeMirror editor, demonstrating the parsing and highlighting of Mustache templates within HTML code.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMode
methods.description: Defines a new mode for CodeMirror, in this case 'mustache' for highlighting Mustache templates.

methods.name: CodeMirror.overlayMode
methods.description: Creates an overlay mode that combines HTML highlighting with Mustache syntax highlighting.

methods.name: CodeMirror.getMode
methods.description: Retrieves the base mode, here 'text/html', for overlaying.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes the CodeMirror editor with the specified mode on the textarea element.
